name: OKC_PRICING_INTEG_SETUP
description: OKC_PRICING_INTEG_SETUP contains Pricing System integration information for retrieving pricing term information from a target system.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Identifier to uniquely locate a Pricing-WS integration record

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: User Name for accessing the Pricing System

columns.name: CSF_KEY_NAME
columns.description: Csf Key name that stores the user name and password of the Pricing System

columns.name: TOPOLOGY_MANAGER_CODE
columns.description: Topology Manager key for storing the endpoint url

columns.name: ACTIVE_YN
columns.description: Active Status of the pricing integration row - Y/N

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS
columns.description: Validation Status of the Pricing - WS Integration record - Incomplete/Complete/Failed

columns.name: VALIDATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the Pricing system was last validated

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
